title: 第1章 穿越伊始-《70年代开局，我靠零元购发家》
content:
第(1/3)页

    火车哐哧哐哧地一路向北疾驰。

    王建新睁开眼，茫然四顾。

    他坐在一排硬座椅子上，周围是嘈杂的人声，还有一股子汗味、脚臭味、不知道什么食物混合的味道。

    “哎，你醒啦？”

    旁边一个戴着眼镜的瘦高个青年探过头来：“刚才你突然晕过去了，吓我们一跳。怎么样，没事吧？”

    王建新没吭声。

    他盯着车厢顶棚看了三秒，然后确认了一个事实——这是绿皮火车。

    硬座车厢。

    满车厢穿着灰蓝绿衣服的年轻人。

    窗外是光秃秃的北方田野，三月的天还冷着，地里啥也没有。

    王建新缓缓闭上眼睛。

    记忆涌上来了。

    他不是这个时代的人。

    三十二岁，一个厨子。前几天骑电动车去买菜，没戴头盔被交警拦了，罚了五十。他一气之下在拼夕夕上买了个“全宇宙最帅”的头盔，到货后试戴——

    然后就没有然后了。

    再睁开眼，就是这趟列车。

    脑子里还多了个东西。

    一个面板，悬浮在意识深处，只有他能看见。

    【元宇宙穿越系统激活成功】

    【宿主：王建新】

    【年龄：15岁（身体）】

    【当前时空：1969年3月】

    【地点：北京开往内蒙古的知青专列】

    【可用技能点：3（已使用）】

    【已选择技能：秘境空间（初级）、宗师医术（完整）、修真功法（炼气篇）】

    王建新盯着这个面板看了足足半分钟。

    然后心里骂了句脏话。

    选技能的时候系统只给了十秒钟，而且只能选三个。上面密密麻麻列了一长串：秘境空间、储物空间、宗师医术、厨艺精通、修真功法、格斗精通、过目不忘、百毒不侵、灵兽驯养、机关术数……个个看着都眼馋。

    他看见“修真功法”四个字眼睛都直了，想都没想就选了。

    结果现在告诉他——只有炼气篇？

    玩呢？

    还有这秘境空间，听着牛逼轰轰的，实际上他意识探进去一看，就是一片光秃秃的土地，大概十来亩的样子，中间有一条小河，水倒是清的，但除此之外什么都没有。

    没有房子，没有种子，没有工具。

    就一块空地。

    王建新深吸一口气，又骂了一句。

    至于宗师医术，倒是完整的。他脑子里现在塞满了各种医书、方剂、脉诀，还有一套叫做“五行针法”的针灸术，仿佛他学了几辈子中医一样，随手就能用。可问题是——他不是来当赤脚医生的啊。

    可问题是——他不是来当赤脚医生的啊。

    “同志，你真没事吧？”眼镜青年又凑过来，一脸担心，“你脸色不太好看，要不要喝点水？”

    王建新睁开眼，摆了摆手：“没事，谢谢。”

    他坐直身体，重新打量四周。

    车厢里闹哄哄的。靠窗的位置有几个女青年在唱歌，“到农村去，到边疆去”，声音稚嫩但充满热情。过道那边有人在争论到了地方是住蒙古包还是住土坯房。还有几个男青年在掰手腕，周围一圈人起哄。

    空气里混杂着汗味、烟味、煮鸡蛋味、咸菜味。

    绿皮火车，硬座真正的硬座，硬木板的，连层海绵也不包，没有空调不说，暖气也没有，就中间有个火炉子。

    一九六九年。

    王建新在脑子里快速过了一遍原主的记忆。

    原主也叫王建新，北京人，今年十五周岁马上十六岁了。父亲王世昌是北京钢厂的四级电工，一个月工资六十七块八。母亲李凤兰没工作，在家操持家务，带五岁的小女儿。大哥王建国二十五岁，钢厂卡车司机，大嫂刘兰兰在供销社当售货员，去年刚生了个闺女，小名叫妞妞。二哥王建军二十岁，在叉车二分厂当工人，工资不高，但也能养活自己。

    一家子普通工人家庭，成分好，属于红五类。

    按政策，他这个初中刚毕业的，就得响应号召上山下乡。

    于是他就坐上了这趟车。

    目的地——内蒙古达茂旗生产队。

    靠近边境。

    王建新摸了摸身上的口袋。

    左边口袋里有个手绢包，打开一看，里头是叠得整整齐齐的钱和粮票。他数了数，三百七十块钱，还有一沓全国粮票。

    三百七十块。

    在这个年代，这不是小数目。

    父亲一个月工资不到七十块，这三百多块差不多是全家半年的积蓄。

    右边口袋里是几个煮鸡蛋，也是用手绢包着，感觉还带着余温。

    裤兜里塞着个笔记本，扉页上写着：赠小弟建新，望保重身体，早日回城。兄建国。

    王建新盯着这行字看了几秒，鼻子突然有点酸。
    第(1/3)页

Page (1/3)

The train sputtered all the way north.

Wang Jianxin opened his eyes and looked around blankly.

He was sitting on a row of hard seats, surrounded by noisy people, and the smell of sweat, foot odor, and unknown food mixed together.

"Hey, are you awake?"

A tall, thin young man wearing glasses looked over and said, "You suddenly fainted just now and surprised us. How are you? Are you okay?"

Wang Jianxin said nothing.

He stared at the roof of the carriage for three seconds, and then confirmed the fact - this was the green train.

​​Hard-seat carriage.

The carriage is full of young people wearing gray, blue and green clothes.

Outside the window is the bare northern fields. It is still cold in March and there is nothing in the ground.

Wang Jianxin slowly closed his eyes.

Memories came flooding back.

He is not from this era.

Thirty-two years old, a cook.A few days ago, I was riding an electric scooter to buy groceries. I was stopped by the traffic police without a helmet and was fined fifty.In anger, he bought the "most handsome helmet in the universe" on Pinxixi and tried it on after it arrived——

And then there is no more.

When you open your eyes again, it’s this train.

There is something more in my mind.

A panel, suspended deep in the consciousness, only he can see.

【The metaverse travel system is activated successfully】

【Host: Wang Jianxin】

【Age: 15 years old (physical)】

【Current time and space: March 1969】

[Location: Special train for educated youth from Beijing to Inner Mongolia]

【Available skill points: 3 (used)】

[Selected skills: Secret Space (Elementary), Grandmaster Medical Skills (Complete), Cultivation Techniques (Qi Refining Chapter)]

Wang Jianxin stared at this panel for half a minute.

Then he cursed in his mind.

When choosing skills, the system only gave you ten seconds, and you could only choose three.There is a long list listed above: secret space, storage space, master medical skills, culinary proficiency, cultivation skills, fighting proficiency, photographic memory, invulnerability to poisons, spiritual beast taming, mechanism skills... They all look greedy.

His eyes widened when he saw the words "cultivation technique", and he chose it without thinking.

Tell him the result now - only the Qi Refining chapter?

How about playing?

There is also this secret space, which sounds awesome. In fact, when he reached in with his consciousness, he saw that it was a piece of bare land, about ten acres in size. There was a small river in the middle, and the water was clear, but there was nothing else.

No house, no seeds, no tools.

It’s just an empty space.

Wang Jianxin took a deep breath and cursed again.

As for the master's medical skills, they are complete.His mind is now filled with various medical books, prescriptions, pulse formulas, and a set of acupuncture techniques called "Five Elements Acupuncture", as if he has studied Chinese medicine for several lifetimes and can use it at will.But the problem is - he is not here to be a barefoot doctor.

But the problem is - he is not here to be a barefoot doctor.

"Comrade, are you okay?" The young man with glasses came over again, with a worried look on his face, "You don't look good, do you want to drink some water?"

Wang Jianxin opened his eyes and waved his hand: "It's okay, thank you."

He sat up straight and looked around again.

The carriage was noisy.There were several young women singing by the window, "Go to the countryside, go to the border." Their voices were childish but full of enthusiasm.Someone across the aisle was debating whether to live in a yurt or an adobe house.There were also several young men wrestling with each other, and people around them were booing.

The air smells of sweat, cigarettes, boiled eggs, and pickles.

Green leather train, hard seats, real hard seats, made of hardwood, not even covered with sponges, no air conditioning, no heating, just a stove in the middle.

1969.

Wang Jianxin quickly ran through the memories of the original owner in his mind.

The original owner is also named Wang Jianxin, a native of Beijing. He is fifteen years old this year and will soon be sixteen.His father, Wang Shichang, is a fourth-level electrician in a Beijing steel factory, earning a monthly salary of 67.8 yuan.The mother, Li Fenglan, is unemployed and takes care of housework and takes care of her five-year-old daughter.The eldest brother Wang Jianguo is 25 years old and is a truck driver in a steel mill. The eldest sister-in-law Liu Lanlan works as a salesperson in a supply and marketing cooperative. She gave birth to a daughter named Niu Niu just last year.The second brother Wang Jianjun is 20 years old and works as a worker in the No. 2 Forklift Branch Factory. The salary is not high, but he can support himself.

The family is an ordinary working-class family with good social status and belongs to the fifth red category.

According to the policy, he, who had just graduated from junior high school, had to answer the call and go to the mountains and countryside.

So he got on the bus.

Destination - Damao Banner production team in Inner Mongolia.

Close to the border.

Wang Jianxin touched his pocket.

There was a handkerchief in the left pocket. When I opened it, I found money and food stamps neatly folded inside.He counted three hundred and seventy yuan and a stack of national food stamps.

Three hundred and seventy yuan.

In this day and age, this is not a small amount.

My father’s monthly salary is less than 70 yuan, and the more than 300 yuan is almost half the family’s savings.

In the right pocket are a few boiled eggs, also wrapped in handkerchiefs, which still feel warm.

There is a notebook stuffed in the trouser pocket, and the title page reads: To my younger brother Jianxin, I hope you can take care of yourself and return to the city as soon as possible.Brother Jianguo.

Wang Jianxin stared at this line of text for a few seconds, and his nose suddenly felt a little sore.
Page (1/3)
title_en: Chapter 1 The Beginning of Time Travel - "At the beginning of the 1970s, I made a fortune by buying goods for zero yuan"
